title: Value Education Crossword
subtitle: Classes III – V  •  CBSE Value Education
instructions: Read each clue carefully and write the answer in the crossword grid — one letter in each box. Every answer is a value or a good habit you have learnt about in your Value Education book.

words.clue: The farmer shared his best corn seeds with all his neighbours so that everyone could grow the best corn. This shows the spirit of ______.
words.explain: The farmer knew that the wind carries pollen from one field to another. If his neighbours grew inferior corn, his own crop would also lose quality. So he shared his best seeds. Together we stand strong, divided we fall.
hints: People combine their efforts instead of trying to do everything alone.
The answer begins with T and has 8 letters.
The first two letters are TE. Complete this pattern: TE______.

words.clue: The little ant fell six times but tried a seventh time and finally climbed the wall. Meera learnt ______ and never to give up.
words.explain: The ant became Meera's role model because it did not give up. Being patient and trying again and again helps us reach our goals.
hints: Waiting calmly and trying again can help when progress is slow.
The answer begins with P and has 8 letters.
The first two letters are PA. Complete this pattern: PA______.

words.clue: Reena remembered 'DROP! COVER! HOLD!' during an earthquake and saved many lives. She knew the rules of ______.
words.explain: Knowing what to do when a disaster strikes saves lives. Remember the golden rule — Prevention is better than cure.
hints: Think about preventing harm and knowing what to do in danger.
The answer begins with S and has 6 letters.
The first two letters are SA. Complete this pattern: SA____.

words.clue: In India, New Year is celebrated as Diwali, Paila Baisakh, Ugadi and Vishu. This shows our unity in ______.
words.explain: We follow different customs, speak different languages and celebrate different festivals, yet we are one country. We must respect and learn from one another.
hints: A group can contain many different traditions and experiences.
The answer begins with D and has 9 letters.
The first two letters are DI. Complete this pattern: DI_______.

words.clue: Feeling and showing concern for your family, friends, neighbours, animals and the environment is called ______.
words.explain: A caring person helps others without expecting a reward, is thankful for what others do, thinks of other people's feelings and is kind to animals and the environment.
hints: Think about showing that another person's well-being matters to you.
The answer begins with C and has 6 letters.
The first two letters are CA. Complete this pattern: CA____.

words.clue: Jai saved a wounded dog from rowdy boys and looked after it. His grandfather taught him this virtue — 'living is giving'.
words.explain: Being kind, loving and helpful towards all living beings is compassion. Happiness never decreases when we share it with others.
hints: Seeing someone suffer can move you to help them.
The answer begins with C and has 10 letters.
The first two letters are CO. Complete this pattern: CO________.

words.clue: Forests, rivers, animals and air — it takes care of all our needs, so we must look after it.
words.explain: Wild animals wander into cities when their forests are destroyed. We must protect forests, save wildlife, say no to polythene bags and keep our surroundings clean.
hints: Think of forests, rivers, wildlife, and other parts of the living world.
The answer begins with N and has 6 letters.
The first two letters are NA. Complete this pattern: NA____.

words.clue: To treat other people, their feelings, their culture and public property with honour is to ______ them.
words.explain: We must respect diverse opinions and cultures, and take care of public property like parks, monuments, hospitals and railway stations.
hints: Treat another person's feelings and ideas as valuable.
The answer begins with R and has 7 letters.
The first two letters are RE. Complete this pattern: RE_____.
